requirements: Every pseudocode_input declares mode, dialect, validation strategy, and stable semantic rule ids.
Write mode requires at least one required-structure rule and two deterministic scenarios.
Trace mode requires expected path, state sequence, output, or operation count.
Reorder mode validates stable step ids rather than displayed strings.
Fill-blanks mode validates semantic operations rather than exact whitespace or variable names.
Hybrid validation combines structure and scenario execution.
AI feedback may elaborate deterministic failures but may not override them.
